usage: The word '個' (go3) is a general measure word used to count people, objects, or abstract things when no specific classifier is required.
It often replaces specific measure words when the speaker is unsure of or wants to simplify the counting.
It is placed between the number and the noun.
'個' can refer to singular or plural items depending on context but is commonly used with singular items.
It is one of the most commonly used measure words in everyday Cantonese.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 ping4 gwo2.
go2 go3 jan4 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5.
cing2 bei2 ngo5 loeng5 go3 zung1 tau4.
keoi5 jau5 saam1 go3 man6 tai4.
